name: io.github.api-freaks/apifreaks-mcp
title: APIFreaks MCP
description: The official MCP server for APIFreaks, connecting your AI to the full range of APIFreaks APIs.

environmentVariables.name: APIFREAKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your APIFreaks API key — get one free at apifreaks.com

environmentVariables.name: APIFREAKS_MODULES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated modules to expose as tools (e.g. ip-intelligence,whois,dns,weather). If unset, only list_modules is advertised. Available: ip-intelligence, geocoding, whois, dns, scraper, email-validation, phone-validation, ssl, domain, screenshot, currency, commodity, financial, zipcode, weather, geography, timezone, user-agent
